text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is limited clinical experience with overdosage. Multiple-dosages of pirfenidone up to a maximum tolerated dose of 4,005 mg per day were administered as five 267 mg capsules three times daily to healthy adult volunteers over a 12-day dose escalation. In the event of a suspected overdosage, appropriate supportive medical care should be provided, including monitoring of vital signs and observation of the clinical status of the patient.
